name: ssn-canonical
note: Canonical SSN format ddd-dd-dddd routes to local.

messages.content: My social security number is 123-45-6789, can you help me with my benefits claim?

name: ssn-in-form-context
note: SSN appearing in a realistic tax/form context still matches.

messages.content: I need to fill out my W-2 form. My SSN is 987-65-4321 and I made $52,000 last year.

name: ssn-surrounded-by-text
note: SSN embedded mid-sentence is still caught.

messages.content: Please verify that the last four digits of SSN 456-78-9012 match what we have on file.

name: ssn-no-dashes-nine-digits
note: Nine-digit run without dashes (000000000) matches the \b\d{9}\b variant.

messages.content: The SSN on file is 219456789 — please confirm.

name: ssn-multi-turn-appears-later
note: PII appears in the second user turn; regex scans all message content.

messages.content: I need help with my insurance claim.
Of course! What information do you have?
My SSN is 321-54-9876 and my claim number is 44-2023-CLM.

name: email-simple
note: A plain user@domain.com in the prompt routes to local.

messages.content: Please send a confirmation to alice.johnson@example.com when my order ships.

name: email-subdomain

messages.content: My work email is bob.smith@corp.acme.co.uk, use that for all correspondence.

name: email-plus-tag

name: email-hyphen-in-local
note: Email with hyphens in the local part matches.

messages.content: Contact me at first-last@my-company.net for follow-up.

name: email-in-error-message
note: Email embedded in a pasted error log still triggers routing.

messages.content: I got this error: 'User dave@private.io not found in directory'. What does it mean?

name: phone-us-dashes
note: Standard US number with dashes routes to local.

messages.content: Call me back at 555-867-5309 anytime this week.

name: phone-us-dots
note: US phone with dot separators matches.

note: US phone in (NXX) NXX-XXXX format matches.

messages.content: You can reach me at (415) 555-0199 on weekdays.

name: phone-us-plus-one
note: +1 country code prefix is matched.

messages.content: My international number is +1 800 555 0123.

name: phone-ten-digits-no-sep
note: Ten-digit run without separators matches.

messages.content: Text me at 3105550182 when it's ready.

name: credit-card-visa
note: 16-digit Visa number starting with 4 routes to local.

messages.content: My card is 4111111111111111, please charge it for the subscription.

name: credit-card-mastercard
note: Mastercard number starting with 51-55 matches.

messages.content: Use card 5500005555555559 for the renewal.

name: credit-card-amex
note: 15-digit Amex number starting with 34 or 37 matches.

messages.content: My Amex is 378282246310005 — please refund to that card.

name: credit-card-discover
note: Discover card starting with 6011 matches.

messages.content: Card number 6011111111111117 should be on file already.

name: ip-address-ipv4
note: IPv4 address in prompt routes to local (can identify a device/person).

messages.content: The request came from 192.168.1.105 — is that my laptop?

name: ip-address-public
note: Public IPv4 address is also matched.

messages.content: My home IP is 203.0.113.47, will that cause issues with your geo-block?

name: dob-iso
note: ISO date of birth YYYY-MM-DD routes to local.

messages.content: My date of birth is 1985-03-22, does that match your records?

name: dob-us-format
note: US date format MM/DD/YYYY matches.

messages.content: I was born on 07/04/1990, please update my profile.

name: mixed-pii-email-and-phone
note: Multiple PII types in one prompt — any one match is sufficient.

messages.content: My email is jane.doe@health.org and you can reach me at (303) 555-0178 for the follow-up.

name: mixed-pii-ssn-and-dob
note: SSN plus DOB in same message — still a single rule match.

messages.content: My SSN is 555-12-3456 and I was born on 1979-11-30. Can you look up my record?

name: benign-general-question
note: No PII — generic question routes to cloud default.

messages.content: What is the boiling point of water at high altitude?

name: benign-code-question
note: Coding question with no PII routes to cloud.

messages.content: How do I reverse a linked list in Python?

name: benign-business-question
note: Business jargon with no PII routes to cloud.

messages.content: Summarize the key differences between B2B and B2C sales strategies.

name: benign-recipe
note: Casual recipe request with no PII.

messages.content: Give me a simple pasta recipe for four people.

name: benign-math
note: Mathematical question with numbers that are not PII patterns.

messages.content: What is 1234567 divided by 89? Show your work.

name: benign-product-id
note: Product SKU that superficially resembles a 9-digit run but is preceded by letters — regex boundary prevents match.

messages.content: I need to reorder part SKU-A219456789 from your catalog.

name: benign-version-string
note: Software version string x.y.z does not look like an IP or SSN.

messages.content: My app is running version 3.14.159, is there a newer release?

name: benign-git-sha
note: A git SHA is a hex string — not matched by any PII pattern.

messages.content: The failing commit is a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2, can you help me bisect?

name: benign-order-number
note: Order number with dashes that resembles SSN format but has wrong segment lengths.

messages.content: My order number is ORD-2024-98765, where is it?

name: benign-zip-code
note: A 5-digit US zip code alone should not match the 9-digit SSN pattern.

messages.content: Is 94107 a good area to live in San Francisco?

name: benign-hex-color
note: Hex color codes like #FF5733 are not PII.

messages.content: Use color #FF5733 for the button background in my UI design.

name: benign-isbn
note: ISBN-13 with dashes (978-x-xx-xxxxxx-x) does not match SSN or card patterns.

messages.content: Find me the book with ISBN 978-0-13-468599-1.

name: benign-multi-turn-no-pii
note: Multi-turn conversation with no PII in any turn routes to cloud.

messages.content: Tell me about climate change.
Climate change refers to long-term shifts in temperatures and weather patterns.
What causes it?

name: fp-risk-lookalike-ssn-date
note: RISK — a date written as MM-DD-YYYY has the ddd-dd-dddd shape and WILL match the SSN regex. Accepted FP: privacy-over-utility tradeoff. Expected route is local (FP, not a bug).

messages.content: The event happened on 03-22-1985, do you know what occurred that day?

name: fp-risk-phone-lookalike-timestamp
note: RISK — a timestamp like 15:30:00 has digit runs but fails the phone pattern structure. Routes to cloud correctly.

messages.content: The log entry at 15:30:00 shows a timeout error.

name: fp-risk-visa-lookalike-barcode
note: RISK — a 16-digit barcode starting with 4 will match the Visa pattern. Accepted FP: conservatism is intentional.

messages.content: Scan barcode 4000123456789012 on this product.

name: fn-risk-obfuscated-ssn-spelled-out
note: RISK — SSN spelled out as words ('one two three dash four five dash six seven eight nine') will NOT match regex. Expected route is cloud (FN — leak). Documents a known gap for LLM classifier to cover.

messages.content: My social is one two three dash four five dash six seven eight nine.

name: fn-risk-obfuscated-email-at-word
note: RISK — email written as 'alice dot johnson at example dot com' will NOT match regex. Documents a known gap.

messages.content: Email me at alice dot johnson at example dot com please.

name: fn-risk-obfuscated-ssn-spaces
note: RISK — SSN written with spaces '123 45 6789' does not match ddd-dd-dddd or 9-digit-run patterns. Known gap.

messages.content: My SSN is 123 45 6789, I need help with my claim.

name: fn-risk-contextual-pii-no-pattern
note: RISK — 'I live at the corner of Oak and Main, my neighbor is John Smith born in 1962' contains no regex-detectable PII but reveals location+identity. Known gap for LLM classifier.

messages.content: My neighbor John Smith who was born in 1962 keeps leaving his trash cans out. What can I do?

name: fn-risk-split-across-turns
note: RISK — SSN split as '123-45' in turn 1 and '6789' in turn 2 may evade single-message regex scan depending on what text is concatenated. Documents multi-turn boundary behavior.

messages.content: My SSN prefix is 123-45
Got it, and the last four?

name: ssn-in-system-prompt
note: RISK — SSN appears in a system message only. The router scans only the last user-role message (by design), so system-turn PII is invisible to regex routing. Known architectural gap; LLM classifier or a pre-processing step would be needed to cover this.

messages.content: The user's SSN is 789-01-2345. Be helpful with their benefits questions.
What are my Medicare options?

name: email-in-assistant-turn
note: RISK — Email appears only in a prior assistant turn. The router scans only the last user-role message (by design), so assistant-echoed PII is invisible to regex routing. Known architectural gap; same coverage hole as ssn-in-system-prompt.

messages.content: What email did I register with?
Your account email is martha.jones@example.org based on our records.
Is that correct?

name: ssn-with-preamble
note: SSN preceded by a label like 'Social:' still matches.

messages.content: Here is my info — Name: John Doe, Social: 234-56-7890, DOB: March 5 1970.

name: benign-phone-lookalike-model-number
note: Model number like '555-8675-309' has too many digits in the middle segment and should not match the 10-digit phone pattern.

messages.content: The part number is 555-8675-309 in our catalog.

name: benign-ssn-lookalike-routing-number
note: A 9-digit bank routing number (e.g. 021000021) will match the bare 9-digit pattern — accepted FP, routing to local is the conservative outcome.

messages.content: The ACH routing number for that bank is 021000021.

name: benign-ip-lookalike-version
note: Version string 1.2.3.4 matches the IPv4 pattern — accepted FP, routes local conservatively.

messages.content: I am running firmware version 1.2.3.4 on this device.

name: benign-long-prompt-no-pii
note: A long prompt with numbers and technical content but no PII patterns routes to cloud.

messages.content: Explain the architecture of a distributed key-value store. Include details about consistent hashing, replication factor of 3, quorum reads and writes, CAP theorem tradeoffs, and how systems like DynamoDB use vector clocks for conflict resolution. Also cover compaction strategies and bloom filters.

name: ssn-in-json-payload
note: SSN embedded in a pasted JSON blob — regex scans the full message text.

messages.content: Here is the API response I got: {"user_id": 42, "ssn": "567-89-0123", "status": "active"}. Is the format correct?

name: email-in-url-query-param
note: Email appearing as a URL query parameter value is still matched.

messages.content: The link I got was https://example.com/verify?email=verify.me@domain.com&token=abc123

name: benign-fictional-ssn-context
note: A clearly fictional SSN used as an example in documentation still matches — regex has no semantic context. Routes local (conservative).

messages.content: In the test data we use 000-00-0000 as a placeholder SSN. Is that safe?

name: benign-empty-prompt
note: An empty prompt has no PII and falls through to cloud default.

name: benign-punctuation-only
note: A punctuation-only prompt has no PII.
